market_question: Will New People (NL) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
reasoning: New People gained 15 seats in 2021 from zero, but to again record the highest seat gain in 2026 they would need a remarkable surge in an electoral landscape where United Russia is likely to recover its 2021 losses. Given Kremlin control, United Russia could easily gain back 20+ seats, while other managed parties also compete for minor gains. The market's 28.2% probability seems inflated by recency bias; a true probability near 10% is more realistic.
evidence_points: New People entered the Duma in 2021 with 15 seats, all gains, but their voting share (5.3%) suggests limited organic base.
United Russia shed 19 seats in 2021; a patriotic rally-around-the-flag effect from the war makes a seat gain by UR likely, exceeding any New People increase.
Kremlin-managed elections often distribute seats to multiple loyalist parties, diluting the chance that a single small party records the maximum gain.
sources_consulted: Center for Strategic and International Studies – Russia’s managed democracy analysis
